title: Disputes
description: Disagreements about orders between clients and providers. The marketplace decides them.

help.title: About disputes
help.overview: A dispute is a disagreement about an order. The marketplace that runs the portal decides it, not you or the client. While it's open, the order's money is frozen: nothing is paid out or accepted.

sections.title: Each dispute
items: Either side can open one on an order that isn't completed or cancelled; one per order. The other side and the marketplace are told.
The marketplace marks it under review, then resolves it for the provider (the work is accepted and the order completed) or closes it for the client (the order is cancelled).
Each decision comes with a note, and both sides are told.
As the provider you can still cancel the order and refund the client while it's open. Nobody else removes a dispute.
At the marketplace, this page lists every company's disputes, and its administrators decide them here.
